title.narrative: Integrating Literacy into Livelihood Skills Development for Rohingya Youth 2024

description.narrative:
The project “Integrating Literacy into Livelihood Skills Development for Rohingya Youth 2024” seeks to develop literacy learning and assessment materials for Rohingya refugee youth learners to equip them with the necessary literacy, numeracy, and transversal skills for meaningful transition to livelihood skills training.
In 2023, UNESCO successfully developed a whole set of literacy learning materials including the textbooks, teachers’ guide and the placement test tool, and conducted Training of Trainers (ToT) for the master trainers from BRAC. The integrated approach adopted by the project helped to associate basic and functional literacy learning with livelihood, soft and life skills development for Rohingya youth and adults.
Based on the findings from the validation and ToT workshops and in consultation with LSDS and implementation partners, UNESCO’s technical assistance in 2024 will aim at enhancing the effective utilization of literacy learning and assessment materials by making interactive eBook available, optimizing the training of trainers and teachers and conducting monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEAL).
